completionContract.rule: Final publication credit requires this schema, the canonical reviewPackageId for the accepted-path workstream, attributable reviewer identity/registration/jurisdiction/qualification/conflict/independence, a substantive reviewScope, exact productSha, SHA-256 evidencePackageDigest and decisionDigest, current validity, a non-future timestamp and a signed artifact reference. ACCEPTED_WITH_CHANGES is not final credit until the specified changes are verified and qualified counsel issues a final accepted record bound to the resulting SHA.
